 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Cincinnati Bengals receiver Tee Higgins was injured during the third quarter of the team's NFL Week 7 game against the Baltimore Ravens at M&T Bank Stadium but returned a short time later to catch Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow's second touchdown pass.
 Higgins' arm and shoulder were observed on the sideline by team medical personnel after taking a huge hit from Ravens defensive back Kyle Hamilton following a 10-yard catch on third down during the Bengals' second drive early in the second half.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Higgins remained on the Bengals' bench after observation. He had a 19-yard catch during the Bengals' next possession, his third reception of the second half. He caught the TD from Burrow later in the same drive.

The Ravens led 13-0 at halftime. (Sam Greene/The Enquirer) Before the bye week, Higgins was dealing with an adductor injury he suffered in a Week 4 loss to Jacksonville.
 Against the Jaguars, Higgins got up slowly after a 19-yard catch near the sideline from quarterback Burrow . Higgins got up, but then took a knee and required attention from team medical personnel.
 Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Tee Higgins (5) grabs his helmet for a drive after being injured in the fourth quarter of the NFL Week 4 game between the Cincinnati Bengals and the Jacksonville Jaguars at Paycor Stadium in Cincinnati on Sunday, Oct. 4, 2026. The Bengals fell to 2-2 on the season with a 22-17 loss at home. Higgins returned to the game later in the drive, and made a catch on his first play back in the game. He was not on the field for the Bengals' final drive of the game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Higgins had a game-high 10 catches for 140 receiving yards before the injury. He added a 17-yard catch, giving him a total of 157 receiving yards, second only to the 194-yard game he had against Baltimore in 2021.
 Higgins made a remarkable touchdown catch from quarterback Burrow late in the second quarter of the team's Week 3 loss to Pittsburgh at Acrisure Stadium. It was among the most impressive NFL catches by Higgins .
 In March 2025, Higgins agreed to a four-year contract extension with the team. Higgins, Cincinnati's second-round pick in the 2020 NFL draft, is entering his seventh NFL season.
